name: Checkin
description: Get live information about your events, tickets, attendees, and sales from the Checkin event registration platform.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Checkin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Checkin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.checkinevent.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Checkin MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Checkin provides these MCP tools: compare-events, event-check-in, event-dashboard, event-finances, event-sales, find-attendees, find-contacts, find-events, find-orders, list-organizations, and organization-details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Checkin?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Checkin in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Checkin requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Checkin is developed by Checkin AS. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
